nodes.characterization_summary: Both catalysts show diffraction peaks at 2θ = 43.4°, 58.0°, and 69.3° corresponding to Ru (101), (102), and (110) with no Mn-based crystalline phase detected.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Both Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C and MnO@Ru/C showed diffraction peaks at 2θ = 43.4, 58.0, and 69.3°, which correspond to Ru (101), (102), and (110), respectively, and no Mn-based crystalline phase was detected (Figure 1a).

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C shows two new vibrations at 427 and 500 cm⁻¹ attributed to Mn-OH compared to MnO@Ru/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Compared with MnO@Ru/C, Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C showed two new vibrations at 427 and 500 cm⁻¹, which could be attributed to Mn-OH (Figure 1b).

nodes.characterization_summary: O 1s shows special Mn-O-H peak in Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C different from Ru-O and Mn-O; Ru 3p electrons show positive shifts of 0.12 eV vs MnO@Ru/C and 0.42 eV vs RuOC.
nodes.evidence_snippet: we analyzed the O 1s orbital energy spectrum of different catalysts (Figure 1c) and found a special Mn-O-H peak in Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C, this is different from those for Ru-O and Mn-O... the 3p orbital electrons of Ru in Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C show positive shifts of 0.12 and 0.42 eV, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Mn K-edge: absorption edge shows slight negative shift with increasing overpotential; FT-EXAFS peaks at 1.35 Å (Mn-O), 1.87 Å (Mn-O-H), 2.85 Å (Mn-Ru longer than Mn-Mn 2.76 Å); Mn coordination: 1 O, 1 OH, 4 Ru atoms forming distorted octahedron.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the absorption edge of Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C shows a slight negative shift as the overpotential increased... The peaks at 1.35 and 1.87 Å could be assigned to Mn-O and Mn-O-H coordination, respectively. Moreover, the peak at 2.85 Å could be attributed to the Mn-Ru interaction, which is significantly longer than the Mn-Mn interaction (2.76 Å)... each Mn atom is coordinated by an oxygen atom, a hydroxyl group, and four Ru atoms in Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C, forming a distorted octahedral coordination structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn content 0.55 wt% in Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C and 0.05 wt% in MnO@Ru/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Inductively coupled plasma-atomic emission spectrometry (ICP-AES) analysis revealed the presence of small amounts of Mn in Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C (0.55 wt %) and MnO@Ru/C (0.05 wt %), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C shows rod-like structures of 100×100×800 nm³; MnO@Ru/C shows amorphous structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to the results of scanning electron microscopy (SEM)... the precursor MnBTC has the rod-like structure of 100 × 100 × 800 nm³ (Figure 2a). The rod-like structure was maintained after annealing and acid etching... The precursor of MnO@Ru/C has an irregular lamellar structure (Figure 2e).

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C shows weaker saturation magnetization, coercivity, and lower EPR strength due to fewer unpaired electrons than MnO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To better understand the Mn clusters, the magnetic properties of the catalyst were measured. Consistent with previous results, the hysteresis loop of the Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C catalyst exhibits a weaker saturation magnetization and coercivity, and the electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) curve also shows a lower strength because Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ has fewer unpaired electrons than MnO.

nodes.characterization_summary: XANES shows absorption edge energy: RuO₂ > Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C > MnO@Ru/C > RuOC > Ru foil; FT-EXAFS shows unchanged Ru coordination structure indicating electronic structure regulation by electron transfer to Mn.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ru K-edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra (Figure 4b, Ru foil and RuO₂ as the reference material) showed a decrease in the energy of the absorption edge by an order of RuO₂ > Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C > MnO@Ru/C > RuOC > Ru foil. However, the Fourier transform of the extended X-ray absorption fine structure (Figure 4c) for MnO@Ru/C, Ru foil, and RuOC revealed that the coordination structure of Ru remains unchanged.

nodes.characterization_summary: Double peaks at 528.4-534.0 eV after 12h chronoamperometry at 0.71 V indicate Mn 3d orbital splitting (e_g and t_{2g}) in Mn-O octahedron confirming Ru→Mn electron transfer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: double peaks appeared in the range from 528.4 to 534.0 eV in the O K-edge spectrum for Mn₁Oₓ(OH)ᵧ@Ru/C after the 12-h chronocurrent (it) test at 0.71 V, which was generated by the splitting of the Mn 3d orbital (e_g and t_{2g}) in the Mn-O octahedron field.
